title: feat(plugin-auth): organizationDeleteGate, a host check in the organization delete admission
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D58H4hn7mx9bRShF3BfEhTw)_

Fixes #32925

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：删除组织（`POST /organization/delete`）新增一个宿主检查挂点 `organizationDeleteGate`（AuthPlugin / AuthManager 选项）。框架自己的检查都通过后、better-auth 开始删数据之前，调用它一次；它可以返回一个拒绝（状态码 + 响应体），框架原样返回，什么都不删。
- **为什么改**：cloud 需要在「订阅还会扣费、环境没清完」时拒绝删除组织。没有挂点时 cloud 只能排在框架的 IP 白名单之前自己解析请求体，解析方式稍有不同就能被绕过（复审已发现一次）。现在宿主直接拿到 better-auth 解析好的 organizationId，而且只有通过 IP 白名单等网关的请求才会问到它。
- **风险与回滚**：不设置该选项时行为完全不变（有对照测试）。宿主函数抛错或返回格式不对时一律 503 拒绝删除（失败即关闭），宿主的错误文字不外泄。回滚 = revert 本 PR；cloud 尚未使用。
- **先看**：① `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-actor-guards.ts` 末尾的 `organizationDeleteGateAnswer`（失败即关闭与拒绝原样返回的判定）；② 同文件 `assertOrganizationDeletable` 最后一段（调用位置：在平台自身拒绝之后）；③ `auth-manager.ts` 里选项的说明与两个导出类型。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/organization-delete-read-fault.test.ts`，预期 19 个用例全绿，其中 `[#32925]` 一组 11 个。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `AuthManagerOptions.organizationDeleteGate` (so also `AuthPluginOptions`, whose options spread into the manager's config): an optional host check, read from the config per call. Two exported types name its contract: `OrganizationDeleteGateRequest` (`organizationId`, `session: { userId, activeOrganizationId?, impersonatedBy? }`, `acceptLanguage?`) and `OrganizationDeleteGateRefusal` (`status`, `body: { code, message, userMessage?, ...host fields }`).
- It is called from the existing delete admission, `assertOrganizationDeletable` (`auth-manager-actor-guards.ts`), which better-auth's `hooks.before` already runs for `/organization/delete`. `auth-manager-before-hook.ts` is not touched. Placement: **last** in the admission, after the platform's own refusals (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED` on the Default Organization's last administrator, `409 DELETE_RESTRICTED` while records remain, `503` on a failed read) and after the vendor-mirroring fall-throughs (no session, not a member, no `organization: ['delete']` permission, no organization row). So it is asked once, only about a delete the platform would let through, and before better-auth's first write.
- Answers: `undefined` / `null` lets the delete go ahead. A refusal with an integer `status` in 400–499 and a body carrying non-empty `code` and `message` (and `userMessage` only as a string) is thrown as `APIError(status, body)`, so status and body reach the client unchanged, host fields such as `steps` included.
- **Fail-closed decision** (the dispatch asked for it to be stated): a check that throws, or answers anything that is neither nothing nor such a refusal (a 2xx or 5xx status, a body with no `code`, `false`, …), is answered `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with a message naming `organizationDeleteGate`, and nothing is deleted. The host's error rides the error's `cause`; its text never reaches the client. A 5xx is not accepted as a refusal: a host's own fault already has its answer (throw), and a refusal is a client error.
- `index.ts` exports the two types. `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` gains a "Deleting an organization" section: the platform's refusals and the host check. Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch.

## Why

The cloud control plane must refuse an organization delete while a subscription will charge again or environments remain. There was no seam between the auth mount's gates (IP allow-list, organization IP-list carrier, one-account refusal) and the better-auth catch-all, so the cloud's guard ran ahead of those gates and re-read the request body itself, which has to match better-call's body parsing exactly (a content-type bypass was found in review). With this option the host gets the id better-auth parsed and runs only for requests the gates admitted, so the cloud can drop its own body reader.

## Verification

Tests: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/organization-delete-read-fault.test.ts` (real `AuthManager` with the organization plugin over ObjectQL + SQLite; the mount test uses `AuthPlugin`'s real mount chain on a Hono app). The new `[#32925]` describe sits in this file because it already holds the delete door's harness (`ownerOfTarget`, the attempted-write recorder), extended with an options argument.

- called once with the parsed id, the caller and `Accept-Language`; answering nothing lets the delete go ahead (200, organization gone);
- CONTROL: no check set, the same delete goes ahead as before;
- its refusal is answered unchanged (409, body deep-equal including `userMessage` and `steps`), nothing attempted (not even better-auth's first write, the session's active organization);
- a body better-auth does not parse (form-encoded, multipart) is better-auth's `415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` and never reaches the check;
- fail-closed, 5 cases (throws; 200; 503; no `code`; `false`): 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` naming the option, host text withheld, nothing attempted;
- a delete the platform refuses never reaches it (401 no session; 409 `DELETE_RESTRICTED` with `dependents`); CONTROL: records gone, the same caller reaches it;
- through the mount: from outside `allowedIpRanges` 403 `IP_NOT_ALLOWED` and the check is never called; CONTROL: from inside, called once and its 409 answered unchanged through the mount.
